        *   The course is designed for students of any musical background or skill level who aim to produce complete, publishable EDM tracks online via Soundcloud, TikTok, and Spotify.

            *   This objective encompasses the theoretical and technical aspects of music production, including sound design, music theory, structure, mixing, and mastering.
        *   Perform / DJ your tracks at Expo!
            *   This objective provides students with the opportunity to showcase their produced tracks in a live setting, such as an expo, promoting their work and gaining performance experience.
    
    In summary, the course is tailored for individuals seeking to develop their skills in EDM production, with a focus on practical application, creativity, and performance. By the end of the course, students will have produced multiple EDM tracks, remixed existing audio, gained knowledge in sound design and music theory, and performed their tracks at an expo.
